purpose: Develop taste and conservative deterministic rules for closed substantive composition episodes; this is not training authority.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_cursor_revision
neighborhoods.rationale: Long prompt with pauses, a middle insertion, a local wording correction, return to the frontier, and later submission evidence.

neighborhoods.label: obsidian_cursor_revision
neighborhoods.rationale: Long-editor passage with corrections to newly authored text and an Accessibility numeric-caret disagreement.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_submitted_single
neighborhoods.rationale: Single ChatGPT query provides a simple submitted-field positive control.

neighborhoods.label: claude_submitted_initial
neighborhoods.rationale: Claude submission tests whether an application newline scaffold is distinct from authored content.

neighborhoods.label: claude_submitted_followup
neighborhoods.rationale: Claude follow-up tests a visible Write-a-message scaffold and selected pre-Return terminal evidence.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_submitted_long
neighborhoods.rationale: Long single ChatGPT prompt is a submitted-field positive control with richer content.

neighborhoods.label: claude_grounded_paste_prompt
neighborhoods.rationale: Typed-paste-typed Claude prompt tests one grounded paste action inside a submitted composition.

neighborhoods.label: gemini_corrective_submission
neighborhoods.rationale: Gemini corrective instruction tests another transient submitted field and pre-Return recovery.

neighborhoods.label: claude_grounded_paste_prompt_two
neighborhoods.rationale: Short typed-plus-document-paste Claude prompt is a second grounded paste control.

neighborhoods.label: claude_mixed_paste_continuation
neighborhoods.rationale: Paste-backed Claude prompt followed by authored continuation tests mixed segments across several low-level WRITEs.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_read_separated_independent
neighborhoods.rationale: Two ChatGPT prompts separated by model output should be rejected as one episode by READ and continuity gates.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_fragmented_long
neighborhoods.rationale: A long prompt continuation split by pauses and cursor boundaries tests reconstruction from a pre-existing authored prefix.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_fragmented_temporal
neighborhoods.rationale: Fragmented ChatGPT writing includes a captured READ and tests whether the proposed bounds must be split.

neighborhoods.label: claude_cursor_fragment
neighborhoods.rationale: Claude prompt is assembled through several cursor-bounded fragments over visible input scaffolding.

neighborhoods.label: chatgpt_causal_protocol
neighborhoods.rationale: Several contiguous ChatGPT fragments develop one causal evaluation protocol before submission.

neighborhoods.label: obsidian_phase1_composition
neighborhoods.rationale: Obsidian paragraph is written in several passes with cursor relocation inside one developing claim.

neighborhoods.label: obsidian_independent_lines
neighborhoods.rationale: Two separate note lines test whether quiet same-document activity should remain two thoughts.

neighborhoods.label: obsidian_disjoint_regions
neighborhoods.rationale: Writes jump between distant regions of one note and include intervening READs; one completion should not be guessed.

neighborhoods.label: obsidian_gtm_composition
neighborhoods.rationale: Two adjacent GTM-note writes test semantic continuity when raw editable identity or intervening evidence disagrees.

neighborhoods.label: code_independent_commands
neighborhoods.rationale: A rapid sequence of terminal commands should remain independent actions rather than one concatenated thought.
